decision_notes: Apply every reviewer/species/scale denominator separately; no aggregate substitution.
Strict frozen synonym interpretation: bounding, striding, trotting, falling, crouching, and vague facing/moving do not silently expand whitelist.
A1 wolf-like canid is not treated as an explicit wolf species assertion. This is a protocol-language limitation; reviewer recognized canid resemblance.
Even crediting all qualified wolf-like species and all non-attack motion synonyms, wolf attack/dead distinctions remain weak and no new pass is claimed.
Numeric animal negative-control calibration FAIL remains independent of semantic review.
Qualified wolf-like recognition sensitivity: A1x wolf species10/10, pose4/10 unchanged, groupFAIL.
retry_recommendation: If leader authorizes the last wolf sheet try, emphasize open mouth enlarged at final scale, lunging forepaws, unmistakably side-lying limp dead posture, and separated frontal stand/walk/run silhouettes. Keep one-scale geometry and no pixel surgery. Two new no-key reviewers would be required; numeric control failure is not fixed by this retry.

qualified_species_sensitivity.rule: Treat first species phrase Wolf-like canid as qualified recognition of intended wolf; retain qualification and dog ambiguity. This supplementary reading does not replace strict frozen scoring.
qualified_species_sensitivity.conclusion: Species is qualified wolf recognition, not total species unrecognizability. Pose FAIL remains.
